harness.classification: POST-HOC EXPLORATORY (development reuse; no confirmatory claim)
harness.labels: canonical cross-platform same-entity pairs; total 29,243; development 23,391
harness.outer_evaluation: 4-fold entity-disjoint out-of-fold over folds 0-3; candidate pairs never cross folds

nested_inner_split.definition: for outer fold f, T = other three folds; c = (f+1) mod 4 is the inner selection fold; A = T minus c
nested_inner_split.hyperparameter_tuning: fit on rows of A, AP on rows of c (labels of f never read)
nested_inner_split.inner_scores: for every g in T: model fit on T minus g, scores rows of g (cross-fitted, never scores own training rows)
nested_inner_split.calibration_fit: on inner scores of A only; method chosen by pooled Brier of a 2-way swap inside A (fit on one fold of A, score the other, both directions); chosen method refit on all of A
nested_inner_split.decision_rule_tuning: on calibrated inner scores of c only (labels, blocking misses of c)
nested_inner_split.outer_scores: model fit on all of T scores fold f; the A-fitted calibrator and c-tuned rule are applied unchanged
nested_inner_split.disclosed_shift: outer model uses 3 folds while calibrator/rule inputs come from 2-fold models

harness.calibration_rule: minimum pooled Brier on the inner 2-way swap; ties -> platt
harness.score_space: probability models: logit of clipped probability; LinearSVM: raw decision value

model_tuning.objective: AP on inner selection fold c

metrics: candidate AP (raw outer scores pooled over 4 folds, mean/SD over seeds)
end-to-end automatic recall = automatic true matches / 23,391
recall if review is perfect = (automatic TP + reviewed positives) / 23,391
cost per pair at FP:FN:REVIEW = 2:1:0.1; FN = true pairs neither auto-matched nor reviewed, including blocking misses; denominator = all cross-platform pairs inside the four development folds
cost sensitivity: the same frozen decisions re-costed at 5:1:0.02
harness.candidate_budget: primary = 1x sparse budget (fold-local count of V2 sparse matched candidates = B0 native count); 2x reported as a secondary PC-only table
